reviews.review:
[b]Following the changes introduced in v1.1.0, I am updating this review with my updated impressions:[/b]

With the scoring system rebalanced, I finally find the game fun! I now can get reasonably good results quicker, and got to experience further tracks and cars - turns out that the first track is quite difficult, and the later ones are considerably more interesting and easier. The AI still doesn't wait for the player if they fall behind, but this is obviously not something that could be fixed in one day (between my original review and the release of v1.1.0).

Following these changes, I'm changing my review from negative to "positive, given the game's low price". Thank you for listening to feedback!


----------------------------------------------------------------------


[b]Original v1.0.0 review below:[/b]

At the first glance, this is quite a cool indie. The handling is really good, much better than I expected at first, and turns out it's well tuned for long, easy drifts. The photo mode rocks! The car roster and customization is impressive! However, I can't experience most of it for one single reason - scoring, and this is also the only reason why I'm leaving a negative review.

The game advertises itself to be chill, but it's the total opposite: It requires you to score a single continuous drift for an ENTIRE 3-4 minute long stage, and if you break the drift anywhere, it's zeroed (not saved as "best drift"!). A single mistake can result in the total score of 0. Then, in the second half, you're required to follow the AI and get more points for drifting close for them, but the AI never waits for you, so once again a single mistake ruins your chances.

It may be a skill issue on my end, sure, but even if, it's happening in the very first stage of the game, and as of the time of writing this review, I was still unable to unlock even the second stage. The same also happened to multiple other people I know who tried the game - even though those people are quite seasoned at arcade racers, they all struggle to get two stars (required to unlock the next stage).

I'm not going to refund the game over a single issue, so instead I'll watch it closely and if scoring ever gets revisited, check it again and edit this review accordingly.
